title: Windows — Windshield Frame — Inspection for Corrosion at the Lower Forward Corner
abstract: One-time inspection of the windshield frame at the lower forward corner for corrosion under the existing sealant, establishing the condition before the drained bracket is installed.

sections.planning_reason: Moisture found behind the corner seal has in eight cases produced light corrosion on the frame land underneath, which is only visible once the sealant is stripped. If the drained bracket is installed over an unrecorded corrosion pit, the pit continues under a seal that will now shed water past it, and the finding surfaces later as a frame repair rather than as a sealant task. Recording the condition first lets the operator plan the repair with the same downtime.
sections.description: This bulletin is an inspection only. With the windshield out, the existing sealant is stripped at the lower forward corner and the frame land is inspected for corrosion, with depth measured where found. The results are returned on the reply form and the acceptance limits determine whether the drained bracket bulletin may proceed directly.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the windshield to AMM-M-56-10-11-000-045-A. Strip the sealant at the lower forward corner and clean the frame land. Do a detailed visual inspection with ten times magnification over the area shown in the bulletin. Where corrosion is found, measure the depth with the supplied gauge and photograph the area against the scale card. Record the results on the reply form. If the depth is within the limit, blend and re-protect locally and proceed to MRD-56-1006. If it exceeds the limit, contact the manufacturer before any further work. Refit the windshield with the existing standard sealant if the drained bracket bulletin is not accomplished at the same visit.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00032 and M00329 that have not embodied MOD-168212. Aircraft already at the post modification standard have had the frame land inspected as part of that embodiment and are excluded.
sections.material_note: No kit. The depth gauge and scale card are supplied on loan with the reply form. Sealant for the refit, if the drained bracket bulletin is not done at the same visit, is the existing standard and is locally held.

type_data.compliance_time: Before accomplishment of Service Bulletin MRD-56-1006, or at the next windshield removal.

tooling: Magnifier, ten times, with scale card
